
# Support

## Getting help

* **Documentation**: read the [README](../README.md) first — it covers download,
  quick start, configuration and building from sources.
* **Bugs & feature requests**: open an issue using the provided issue templates
  (bug report / feature request).
* **General questions**: use GitHub Discussions if enabled on this repository.

## Portable application request

If you want another application to be *portapped*, please follow
[this guide](https://portapps.io/doc/request-app/) to file a proper request report.

## Closure policy

* Issues that go a week without a response from the original poster are subject
  to closure at our discretion.
* Duplicate issues will be closed and linked to the original report.
